title: Scalar-compatible canonical base change for additive first cohomology
statement: Let $k\to k'$ be an algebra map of algebraically closed fields. Let $f:C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be smooth, proper and connected with dimension at most one [def-sc-curves, def-weil-proper-morphism], and let $C'$ with maps $f',j$ be its displayed cartesian base change. Let $G,G'$ be abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] equipped with natural additive section equivalences $a,a'$ to the regular functions on every etale object. Let $q:j^*G\to G'$ have adjoint whose section formula under $a,a'$ is ring pullback along $U\times_C C'\to U$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. There are a finite-dimensional $k$-module $V$ and additive equivalences $b:H^1(G)\simeq V$, $b':H^1(G')\simeq k'\otimes_k V$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. For each $c\in k$ there is an endomorphism of $G$ which acts on sections by multiplication by the structural image of $c$, and whose cohomology map becomes multiplication by $c$ under $b$; the same holds for $c\in k'$ and $G'$ under $b'$. The structural image on $U$ is the composite $k\simeq\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}k,\mathcal O)\to\Gamma(C,\mathcal O)\to\Gamma(U,\mathcal O)$, and analogously on $C'$. Moreover $b'(H^1(q)(j^*x))=1\otimes b(x)$ for all $x\in H^1(G)$, where $j^*x$ is the canonical cohomology pullback. No Frobenius endomorphism or Artin--Schreier row is asserted.

proof.text: The natural section equivalences identify G and G' with the lifted additive structure sheaves. Use etale/Zariski quasi-coherent comparison and the natural Ext/derived comparison to identify their H^1 with coherent structure-sheaf H^1. Proper coherent finiteness gives a finite-dimensional k-module V and its additive comparison b.

Conjugate multiplication by each structural scalar on regular functions to sheaf maps mu_c. Their naturality follows from the structure morphism triangle. The zero, identity, addition and multiplication identities hold sectionwise. The cohomology comparison natural in module maps carries H^1(mu_c) to scalar multiplication on V. Perform the same construction on C'.

Apply flat coherent base change to the structure module and transport it to the displayed cartesian square, with tensor factors interchanged. Compose with etale/Zariski and Ext/derived comparisons to obtain b'. Scalar naturality identifies each H^1(mu_c) with the k' action.

Choose a finite affine cover of the proper, hence separated and quasi-compact curve and its pullback cover. The adjoint formula for q gives the canonical cochain map s to 1 tensor s on sections and all intersections. Flat tensoring commutes with kernels and images. The natural Cech/cohomology comparisons therefore yield b'(H^1(q)(pullback x))=1 tensor b(x), in the specified Ext model. For dimension zero both coherent H^1 groups vanish, so the same construction gives zero modules.

theorem exists_additive_scalar_base_change
    {k k' : Type u}
    [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Field k'] [IsAlgClosed k'] [Algebra k k']
    {C : Scheme.{u}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsCurve f] [Smooth f] [ConnectedSpace C] [IsProper f]
    {C' : Scheme.{u}} {f' : C' ⟶ Spec (.of k')} {ι' : C' ⟶ C}
    (h : IsPullback ι' f' f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))))
    (G : Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (G' : Sheaf C'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (a : ∀ U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ, G.obj.obj U ≃+ Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))
    (a' : ∀ U : C'.Etaleᵒᵖ, G'.obj.obj U ≃+ Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))
    (ha : ∀ (U V : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (g : U ⟶ V) (x : G.obj.obj U),
      a V (G.obj.map g x) = g.unop.left.appTop (a U x))
    (ha' : ∀ (U V : C'.Etaleᵒᵖ) (g : U ⟶ V) (x : G'.obj.obj U),
      a' V (G'.obj.map g x) = g.unop.left.appTop (a' U x))
    (q : (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ι').obj G ⟶ G')
    (hq : (∀ (U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : G.obj.obj U),
        a' (Opposite.op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ ι').obj U.unop))
          (((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ι').homEquiv
            G G' q).hom.app U x) =
          (Limits.pullback.fst U.unop.hom ι').appTop (a U x))) :
    ∃ (V : ModuleCat.{u + 1} k) (_ : FiniteDimensional k V)
      (b : Sheaf.H G 1 ≃+ V) (b' : Sheaf.H G' 1 ≃+ (k' ⊗[k] V)),
      (∀ c : k, ∃ μ : G ⟶ G,
        (∀ (U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : G.obj.obj U),
          let ρ : k →+* Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤) := U.unop.hom.appTop.hom.comp
            (f.appTop.hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv.hom)
          a U (μ.hom.app U x) = a U x * ρ c) ∧
        ∀ x : Sheaf.H G 1,
          b (Sheaf.H.map μ 1 x) = c • b x) ∧
      (∀ c : k', ∃ μ : G' ⟶ G',
        (∀ (U : C'.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : G'.obj.obj U),
          let ρ : k' →+* Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤) := U.unop.hom.appTop.hom.comp
            (f'.appTop.hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k')).inv.hom)
          a' U (μ.hom.app U x) = a' U x * ρ c) ∧
        ∀ x : Sheaf.H G' 1,
          b' (Sheaf.H.map μ 1 x) = c • b' x) ∧
      ∀ x, b' (Sheaf.H.map q 1 (Etale.cohomologyMap ι' G 1 x)) = 1 ⊗ₜ[k] b x
